electrocatalysis_experiments.working_electrode: polycrystalline Cu powder on carbon fiber paper

evidence.text_snippet: The onset potential of n-propanol in the oxygen-free atmosphere occurs at as negative as −0.90 VRHE
to achieve a similar rate of ~0.5 mA cm−2 requires an additional 250 mV overpotential, i.e., −1.00 VRHE
while in the absence of O2, it is not observed until a much more negative potential of −0.95 VRHE

electrocatalysis_experiments.working_electrode: polycrystalline Cu powder on carbon fiber paper

evidence.text_snippet: The formation of n-propanol is also observed at −0.75 VRHE with a partial current density of ~0.5 mA cm−2 in the presence of O2
The onset of methane production is improved to as early as −0.75 VRHE in an oxygen-containing atmosphere
